prompt: Raise both of his arms outward so each arm is held straight and angled 45 degrees away from his body, like a letter A, with clear empty space between each arm and the coat, open gloved hands with fingers apart. Everything else stays exactly the same: the beaked mask, hood, long dark leather coat, belts, boots, colours, framing and plain light grey background.

passes.prompt: Change his pose only: he now stands facing the camera straight on, symmetrical, in an A-pose with both arms held straight down and out at 40 degrees from his body, empty open gloved hands, feet shoulder-width apart. Remove both swords completely. Keep the same beaked mask, hood, long dark leather coat, belts and boots, same colours and materials. Plain light grey background.

note: Pass 0 (the long prompt, seed 190926, guidance 2.5) kept his three-quarter pose and swords and only saturated colour: rejected. Pass 1 seed 190926 kept a sword: rejected. The Space returns WebP; the kept file is re-encoded PNG and its sha256 is of that PNG.
